name: business-dashboard
description: Business dashboard on Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "wrangler dev --port 8787" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply bizdash --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply bizdash-demo --local
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply bizdash --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply bizdash-demo --remote
scripts.db:backup: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('backups',{recursive:true})" && wrangler d1 export bizdash --remote --output backups/bizdash-backup.sql
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install
